description: Read one known job, including errors, elapsed time and content references. Use list_jobs to recover a lost ID. Stop on completed, completed_with_errors, failed, cancelled, or awaiting_review. Article jobs add kit_status, kit_revision, kit_confidence and review_reasons for the item's content kit: awaiting_review with kit_status needs_review is a held kit, so read it with get_content_kit, edit it if asked, then approve_content_kit (the write runs as a new job on the item) or reject_content_kit; any other awaiting_review is editorial review. Check failure details; a job ID alone is not a finished draft. Poll at least 30 seconds apart and honor Retry-After.
name: get_job
